first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A low blue open-wheel single-seat race car with white trim, blue-and-white front and rear wings, and exposed black tires; the rear-wing endplate bears the white number 6.

entities.name: gray asphalt racetrack
entities.identification: A broad gray paved racetrack surface with white lines along the edges and light and dark streak-like marks on the surface.

entities.name: grass shoulder
entities.identification: A continuous green grassy area beside the racetrack, interspersed with yellow-green and dark green patches.

entities.name: metal guardrail
entities.identification: A silver-gray horizontal elongated guardrail partially visible along the upper-left edge in frame 0.

entities.name: blue-and-white segmented curb
entities.identification: A narrow curb extending along the edge of the racetrack, with alternating blue and white segments.

entities.name: green paved runoff area
entities.identification: A flat light green paved strip outside the blue-and-white segmented curb in the lower-left of frame 42.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person wearing a helmet with alternating light and dark areas in Vehicle A's cockpit, with most of the body occluded by the vehicle body.

entities.name: orange raised curb strip
entities.identification: A narrow elongated orange raised strip on the grass side of the blue-and-white segmented curb.

entities.name: orange block at the end of the guardrail
entities.identification: A small orange block-like area exposed near the right end of the metal guardrail along the upper edge in frame 0.

entities.name: gray paved strip outside the racetrack
entities.identification: A narrow gray paved area farther beyond the grass in the upper-right of frame 42, near the upper edge of the image.
